name: @dinobros/construct3-plugin-template
description: An opinionated ready-to-use Construct 3 Plugin template based on TypeScript & Vite.js. 🎮

scripts.dev: rm -rf .build && mkdir -p .build && concurrently -P --kill-others --prefix "[{name}]" --prefix-colors "magenta,yellow,cyan" --names "EDITOR,RUNTIME,SERVER" "vite build -c vite.config.editor.ts --watch" "vite build -c vite.config.runtime.ts --watch" "vite preview -c vite.config.runtime.ts --outDir .build --port 5173 {@}" --
scripts.build:only: rm -rf .build && vite build -c vite.config.editor.ts && vite build -c vite.config.runtime.ts
scripts.build: rm -rf .build && vite build -c vite.config.editor.ts --sourcemap false && vite build -c vite.config.runtime.ts --sourcemap false && mkdir -p dist/ && rm -f dist/Dinobros_Construct3PluginTemplate-v$(jq -r .version package.json).c3addon && cd .build/ && zip -r ../dist/Dinobros_Construct3PluginTemplate-v$(jq -r .version ../package.json).c3addon *
